items.q: I was fortunate enough to have Rex Stewart in my band with the Wilberforce Collegiates, along with Benny Carter

ctx.x: -- but actually it was a great experience for me because they all had different personalities; yet they were great musicians, and, of course, starting out with Rex Stewart, I was fortunate enough to have Rex Stewart in my band with the Wilberforce Collegiates, along with Benny Carter.
